find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/numpy -name "*.so" -exec sh -c 'head -c 4 "$1" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d " \n"' _ {} \; | sort -u
find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/scipy -name "*.so" 2>/dev/null | head -5 | while read f; do echo -n "$f: "; head -c 4 "$f" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d ' \n'; echo; done
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate testbed && conda list numpy scipy
find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages -name "*.so" -exec sh -c 'head -c 4 "$1" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d " \n"' _ {} \; | sort -u
find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages -name "*.so" -exec sh -c 'head -c 4 "$1" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d " \n"' _ {} \; | grep -c "^7f454c46"
find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages -name "*.so" -exec sh -c 'head -c 4 "$1" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d " \n"' _ {} \; | grep -c "^251f6350"

for f in $(find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages -name "*.so"); do h=$(head -c 4 "$f" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d ' \n'); if [ "$h" = "7f454c46" ]; then echo "VALID: $f"; else echo "CORRUPT: $f"; fi; done | head -20

valid=0; corrupt=0; for f in $(find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages -name "*.so"); do h=$(head -c 4 "$f" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d ' \n'); if [ "$h" = "7f454c46" ]; then valid=$((valid+1)); else corrupt=$((corrupt+1)); fi; done; echo "Valid: $valid, Corrupt: $corrupt"

for f in $(find /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages -name "*.so"); do h=$(head -c 4 "$f" | od -A n -t x1 | tr -d ' \n'); if [ "$h" != "7f454c46" ]; then echo "$f" | sed 's|/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/site-packages/||' | cut -d'/' -f1; fi; done | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate testbed && pip uninstall -y numpy scipy 2>&1 | tail -5
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate testbed && pip install numpy scipy 2>&1 | tail -10
source /opt/miniconda3/bin/activate testbed && conda install numpy scipy --force-reinstall 2>&1 | tail -20
